description: Change of use of ground floor from Financial and professional services (Use Class A2) to Non-residential institution/education and training centre (Use Class D1).
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Drawings 49.00.01, 49.00.02 and 49.00.03 and Planning Statement [received on 21/02/2020]) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The two units (1A and 3A Sutton Court Road) shall be restricted to use as a non-residential institution / education and training centre within Use Class D1 and shall be used for no other purposes.

Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted for education and training centre purposes shall not be carried on outside the following times:
8 am until 8 pm Mondays to Saturdays, not at all on Sundays and Bank Holidays.
